results: Gaussian inversion and Riesz negative-half-moment normalization are correct.
Rough scalar, definite-pair, and hyperbolic-pair formulas are valid as measure domination via nonnegative tests and Tonelli.
The manuscript correctly limits global output regularity to essential boundedness; only the no-pivot L1-Fourier branch is automatically C0.
Projection proof has a harmless restricted-index equality that should be an inequality.
A bare order-four 1/|t| envelope cannot by itself lower the theorem from 17 to 13.
remaining_gap: No lower multiplicity was certified. A 13-direction proof needs additional quadratic/product structure at the critical order-four endpoint.
